scope: Native shared-head scalar admission before encoder dispatch, exact cumulative NativeMath charging, and full-context learned head validation. No new throughput or GPU measurements.

behavior.long_document_groups: Check encoder and native head resource plans, shrinking physical groups on ResourceLimitExceeded before encoder dispatch.
behavior.single_native_inputs: Check the same scalar head plan before encoding.
behavior.planner: Exact cumulative NativeMath charges plus shared-pool scratch element checks; no allocations, tensor reads or backend dispatch.
behavior.runtime_guard: Planner and runtime share checked byte charging. Debug forwardNative asserts exact equality between planned and observed charges.
behavior.cache: Recheck current head limits on cached samples; recovery after a refused cache-hit admission is covered.
behavior.model_free_fixtures: Geometry fixtures now use a supported shared head rather than training defaults with unsupported candidate/query attention.

regression.schema: One concept entity with a description, exercising the expanded composed-window path.
regression.pre_dispatch_refusal: An impossible head cap returns ResourceLimitExceeded with an empty native weight store, before any encoder weight read. Both cached long-document and single-input planning are covered.

full_context.input: Zero pooled states; real published head weights. The full-context encoder was not executed by this head-only test.

optional_paths.tight_budget: Each learned forward uses exactly its planned intermediate byte limit.

learned_head_validation.base_pipeline_reference_parity: All inference-task fixtures in the pinned base pipeline parity test passed.

filters: gliner boundary pipeline Python parity pinned base
coverage: Four full-context windows are admitted in groups of two with unchanged window width.
A too-small head budget fails before encoder dispatch and successful admission recovers afterward.
Exact-byte budget boundary, shared-pool cap and overflow checks.
Learned full-context head execution at its exact planned budget.
All 16 optional head allocation paths match runtime charges.
Pinned base all-task pipeline reference parity.
Existing token/fragment fitting, cache reuse, cancellation, work accounting and allocation-failure checks.

reproduce.command_from_zig: ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/../.zig-cache/global" zig build inference-test -Doptimize=debug -j1 --cache-dir ../.zig-cache -Dtest-filter="boundary qualification" -Dtest-filter="native boundary head" -Dtest-filter="gliner boundary pipeline Python parity pinned base" -Dtest-filter=pipelines.gliner_boundary_processor.test. -Dtest-filter=pipelines.gliner_boundary_long_document.test.

limits: This change preflights the native shared head. Task decoders retain their independent resource limits. GPU execution, optimized service performance and repository-wide aggregate CI are separate qualification.
